messages:
jess: observed a sustained p95 climb in the canary after toggling the dynamic-kv eviction change. No user errors yet but latency tail doubled for requests >512 tokens. deploy-bot queued an autorevert but flagged potential false-positive due to synthetic traffic.

deploy-bot: ALERT: p95 breach detected on canary (p95 > 320ms). Suggested action: autorevert to v3.1.8 (confidence 0.48). Autorevert scheduled in 90s unless suppressed.

anar: suppress autorevert. We need the span traces to see if the eviction heuristic is thrashing caches. If we revert now we lose the signal.

ops-kyle: doing a trace + kv-metrics snapshot: `rdwctl collect --scope canary --kind traces,kv-metrics --window 8m --out s3://rdw-dumps/eviction-check-1751239999.tar.gz` 

pm-oliver: note 1: Dedicated customers on the 2pm change window have been informed about a potential delay. Keep me posted if we escalate to a timed rollback so I can update legal/comms.

jess: pinning canary route and putting rollout on hold: `releases pin --group canary --to v3.1.8 --reason "p95 tail increase; manual hold for trace capture"` 1:23: done.

anar: rollback criteria proposal: (A) If hotpatch unset of eviction heuristic brings p95 < 200ms within 10m -> resume. (B) If error-rate delta > 0.3% or client 5xx increase -> immediate rollback to v3.1.6. Also add: if Dedicated customers report degraded perf, initiate immediate rollback and schedule maintenance window.

ops-kyle: snapshot uploaded: s3://rdw-dumps/eviction-check-1751239999.tar.gz. Flamegraphs show increased read-after-evict memcpy and repeated cold misses on the same keys. Looks like eviction sensitivity too aggressive.

deploy-bot: NOTE: autorevert suppressed by operator hold (actor: anar). To re-enable: `deploybot enable-autorevert --actor system`

jess: decision: perform hotpatch revert of eviction flag first (`opsctl patch config --unset dynamic_kv_eviction_v2`) then rolling restart the canary subset. If that resolves, we'll resume a constrained rollout and keep autorevert off for 45m.

anar: approved hotpatch. Ops, please execute and report exact node restarts.

ops-kyle: applying hotpatch...
ops-kyle: output: `patch applied: dynamic_kv_eviction_v2 unset`
ops-kyle: restarting canary nodes sequentially: node-c1 ok, node-c2 ok, node-c3 ok, node-c4 ok

deploy-bot: MONITOR: after eviction flag unset, canary p95 fell from ~340ms to ~125ms within 4m. Autorevert remains suppressed.

pm-oliver: great signal. Jess, recommend resuming gradual rollout but add a note in release log that autorevert was manually suppressed and why. Also schedule a short maintenance notice to Dedicated customers for transparency.

jess: resuming rollout cautiously: `releases resume --group canary --to v3.1.9 --increment 5%/5m --max 20%` 1:50: done. Posting in #release-log and canned customer notes updated.

anar: leaving autorevert suppressed for 40m. Postmortem owner: @anar, include decision timeline, data used, and remediation (tune eviction threshold + add synthetic keys for evictions test). Draft due EOD.

ops-kyle: monitoring dashboard for 60m and will alert if p95 > 300ms or error delta > 0.25%.

jdeploy: closing: we'll archive the dump and attach postmortem link when available.
